name: vite-react-typescript-starter

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json

_lockfileNote: @emnapi/core and @emnapi/runtime below are not imported by this app. They are transitive dependencies of @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi (an optional dependency of rolldown, pulled in by vite/vitest). npm on Windows records that binding in package-lock.json but does not resolve its dependencies, because the binding is not installable here — leaving the lockfile naming packages it has no entries for. Linux npm does walk that subtree, so `npm ci` fails there with EUSAGE 'Missing: @emnapi/core from lock file'. Declaring them here forces npm to resolve them on every platform, so a lockfile regenerated on Windows can no longer omit them. Remove once rolldown no longer depends on a wasm32-wasi binding.
